headline: Twelve straight wins for the Red Sox as Fenway rocks
morning_brew: Twelve in a row and the atmosphere at Fenway is flat out electric. Watching this team scrap and claw back against the Rays on Saturday night reminded me exactly why we put up with all the heartbreak and bad coffee of a long season. They were down early but never panicked, and the way they bullied their way back into the lead shows a kind of grit that makes me think this might actually lead somewhere special come autumn.

Willson Contreras brought the thunder with a blast that shifted the tide, and our bullpen shut the door with the kind of precision I haven't seen in years. Sonny Gray gave us six innings of absolute beauty before handing the keys to the relievers, who made sure that cushion was plenty. I am officially making another fat deposit into the Duck Boat fund because this streak has reached the point where I'm starting to get nervous just talking about it.

My neighbor Rick is currently trying to build a dossier proving the league is terrified of our momentum, claiming the umpires were looking for any excuse to slow us down. I told him to put the tinfoil hat away and just enjoy the damn ride while the getting is good. We have the Orioles coming into the Hub tonight, and if we keep playing this brand of ball, the rest of the league better watch their backs.

news_digest.headline: Red Sox rally for victory over Rays for 12th straight win
news_digest.dans_take: Twelve straight is pure insanity, this group has found a gear I wasn't even sure existed.
